title: Launcher --notify with a bare session id on a federated runner resolves to that runner's own host and fails 404 at completion
outcome: A detached launcher run started on a federated runner host with --notify naming a session on another host either delivers its completion to that session or is refused at launch, before any stage runs. It never accepts a bare id that resolves to the runner's own local host and then fails at completion.
acceptance: Launcher --notify with a bare session id on a federated runner resolves to that runner's own host and fails 404 at completion is done
